messages:
Ravi: Heads up — nightly recompute job `agg-recompute-03-20` surfaced a silent failure yesterday: it stopped after processing 12 shards due to a quota bump, but console preview had shown it would succeed. Anybody seen mismatches between preview and actual run recently?
Nora: Hmm, was the preview run using the "console_preview" estimator? We had a divergence after we enabled adaptive-batching for hosted routes.
Chen: I pulled the run logs: the job received routing_policy=cost_aware at dispatch, which intentionally limits burst to preserve SLOs. Console preview defaulted to routing_policy=preview_burst which allows temporary capacity.
Marta: That explains success in preview but failure in prod. We should be explicit: console preview should either simulate the exact routing policy for the target environment (hosted/dedicated/private) or warn the operator.
Ravi: For this customer the job was targeted at hosted. Console preview should have used hosted policy. Was there a bug where preview mapping used the org default instead of target cluster policy?
Chen: Yes, mapping bug: preview used account_default_policy from user prefs, not the selected deployment target. Filed a quick PR to fix mapping.
Nora: UX idea: show a small badge on the preview card: "Simulated policy: hosted (burst_allowed)" and an expandable section listing differences vs production live policy.
Marta: Also add a parity test: when preview is generated, run a headless preflight with production mapper and log parity metrics. If an >10% difference in estimated tokens or time, surface a warning.
Ravi: Agreed. Operationally we also need an emergency flow for a stuck backfill: a one-time resume token that can be requested with an approval chain. The token should be time-limited and logged in audit.
Chen: opsbot: created task ENG-7045 "preflight: align preview policy mapping + resume token workflow" with acceptance criteria.
opsbot: Task ENG-7045 created and added to eng-platform backlog.
Nora: For implementation: (1) fix policy mapping in preview service, (2) add preview metadata fields estimator_version and simulated_policy to the JSON returned by preview endpoint, (3) console shows them and warns on mismatch.
Marta: For tests: add 5 tenants sampling nightly where preview and production preflight are compared; export metrics preflight.preview_vs_prod_diff_percent. Alert if >8%.
Ravi: I'll own the API change for preview metadata. Nora, can you pick up the UI badge and warning copy?
Nora: Yep, will do. I'll also add a tiny "why this matters" tooltip explaining burst vs conservative routing.
Chen: After mapping fix I re-ran the nightly job in a dry-run — estimates match now and the job would have passed under hosted policy.
Marta: Nice. Let's land ENG-7045 and add a small note in the runbook about checking preview.policy before kicking large reprocesses.
Ravi: Thanks all. If anyone wants to pair on the parity tests tomorrow morning ping me.
